LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Forge: A society dedicated to the Forge of Days, pursuing transformation through craft, heat, and relentless reshaping.
LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Grail: A society dedicated to the Red Grail, celebrating appetite, delight, and the ceaseless feast.
LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Edge: A society dedicated to conflict and conquest, sharpening its faithful through struggle and rivalry.
LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Winter: A society dedicated to endings, frost, and quiet remembrance of what cannot remain.
LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Heart: A society dedicated to the Thunderskin and preservation, sustaining life through unceasing rhythm.
LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.Moth: A society dedicated to the Moth and the Wood, embracing yearning, shedding old skins, and restless change.
LanguageData.Cultist.SuspicionRaidBody: Suspicion swept the rimworld while your notoriety exceeded 75% of the threshold. The Suppression Bureau has launched an immediate raid!
LanguageData.Cultist.SuspicionSeasonQuiet: A season of suspicion passes over the colony. Notoriety rose slightly, though not yet enough to trigger a raid.

LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.Title: Poppy Lascelles — High-Risk Patronage
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.Desc: Offers an immediate grant of 600 silver and 5 spintriae. In 10 days she will demand a follower—or 10 spintriae—in return.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.AidAccepted: Poppy Lascelles delivered 600 silver and 5 spintriae. Her debt comes due in 10 days.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.DueBody: Ten days have passed. Poppy Lascelles demands settlement of her bargain: surrender one follower (not the leader), buy out the debt with 10 spintriae, or refuse and face her wrath.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.ChoiceRefuse: Refuse Poppy (Rival Long raid + Fear + Notoriety)
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.PaidSpintria: Poppy accepted 10 spintriae and delivered a Tier 4 lore volume.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.PaidFollower: {0} departed into Poppy's service. A Tier 4 lore volume was delivered in return.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.NoFollower: No eligible non-leader colonist is available to surrender.
LanguageData.Cultist.Poppy.WrathBody: You defaulted on Poppy Lascelles's bargain. Hostile servants have been dispatched to punish the colony.

LanguageData.Cultist.ChurchDescription.SecretHistorie: An occult society dedicated to the study of the five Histories and their thousand demi-real branches. St Hydra accepts all aspects equally, though it has no Exalted rank.
LanguageData.Cultist.StHydraNoExalted: The Society of St Hydra has no Exalted third rank.
LanguageData.Cultist.Vagabond.LetterBody: The Vagabond is the one Hour who can never enter the Mansus, but she goes everywhere else... and, if you believe her boasts, she's the only one who knows all the Histories. Sometimes, she lets someone record her travels. While summoning the Anomaly, you inadvertently glimpsed her aspect as the Laughingthrush.
